newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Czechs keen about expanded ties with Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Czechs keen about expanded ties with Singapore.

text.p: Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus welcomed on Tuesday expanded economic ties with Singapore, saying Prague must diversify its trade after losing its markets in the former Soviet Union and Eastern Europe.

"We have to diversify our trade," Klaus told reporters after a whirlwind 10-hour visit to Singapore where he met President Ong Teng Cheong, Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong and other senior leaders of the city-state.
"We are extremely interested (in joint ventures) here. We welcome Singapore investors to Czech republic. I hope it will be a good beginning," he added.
Klaus was accompanied by a 30-man business delegation during his visit.
